sections.heading: WATCHES AND WARNINGS
sections.text: A Hurricane Warning is in effect for the coast of Haldane Parish. A Storm Surge Warning is in effect for the same coast.

sections.heading: DISCUSSION AND OUTLOOK
sections.text: At 400 PM CDT, the center of Hurricane Marlena was located near latitude 25.1 North, longitude 90.2 West. Marlena is moving toward the north near 10 mph and a turn toward the north-northeast is expected. Landfall is forecast late Thursday.

sections.heading: HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND
sections.text: STORM SURGE: Life-threatening inundation of 6 to 9 feet above ground is possible along the coast. RAINFALL: 8 to 12 inches with isolated higher totals.
